dump_clip_text_features: dump CLIP text features for PASCAL Part categories and save to a PyTorch checkpoint file
generate_part_prompts: generate CLIP text prompts from PASCAL Part category names with configurable prompt templates
encode_clip_text_embeddings: encode text embeddings using a CLIP model with optional batching for large input sets
filter_dog_categories: filter PASCAL Part categories to include only dog-related part classes
save_clip_features_torch: save CLIP text features as a PyTorch tensor to a specified output path
